Alisha (CEO): Quick note — all-hands tomorrow 10:30am PT. Please skim the agenda and drop any Qs here. Recording will be posted after. :calendar:

Ben (VP Eng): High-level agenda: company pulse, Dedicated rollout update, customer highlight, 3 lightning demos, reliability brief, Q&A. Plan for 45m.

Carmen (Product): Helpful if each team posts 1-2 sharper questions. We'll surface the top ones live. Prefix with 'Q:' so we can filter.

Dave (Ops): Heads-up: Friday's deploy window may shift if Q&A goes long — ops will coordinate.

Alisha (CEO): Agenda (one-line items):
- Company pulse (Alisha)
- Platform priorities & Dedicated launch status (Ben)
- Customer story: Raccoon Health (Carmen)
- Reliability updates & incident safeguards (Dave)
- Lightning demos (3 teams, 5m each)
- Open Q&A (15m)

Ben (VP Eng): Teams who want to demo DM me title + 1 slide by EOD. Focus on measurable impact (latency/cost/customer metric).

Carmen (Product): Async folks — drop your Qs in this thread with 'Q:' and we'll compile a full doc to link in the recording notes.

Allhands Bot: Calendar invite created: https://company.calendar/meet/10-30-allhands — recording available ~1h after end.

Raj (Platform Eng): Q: Any change to Dedicated rollout cadence?

Alisha (CEO): Raj — short answer: GA target unchanged, but rollout zones reprioritized to support regulatory customers first. We'll explain more tomorrow.

Lina (Support): Q: Where will incident follow-ups/postmortems be published if mentioned?

Dave (Ops): Lina — postmortems will be in #postmortems and linked from the all-hands notes. We'll avoid naming customers unless cleared by legal.

Marta (Sales): Q: Will there be a one-line pricing change note for Dedicated we can use for customer comms?

Carmen (Product): Marta — Yes, we'll give a brief customer-facing line during the call; exact collateral will be circulated after the meeting.

Noah (Eng): Demo request submitted: "KV-cache tuning -> ~2x token cost reduction" (DMed Ben).

Ben (VP Eng): Also planning to mention a small default batching config change for new Dedicated clusters — ops will publish the config snippet and rollout timeline post-call.

Dave (Ops): Preview config snippet:
```
default_batch_size: 64
default_max_latency_ms: 180
rolling_restart: true
```

Alisha (CEO): One ask for leaders: bring one win to celebrate and one thing you need company help on. Short callouts only.

Carmen (Product): We'll collate questions and publish the full Q&A doc alongside the recording. Drop Q: items here by EOD if you can't join.

Ben (VP Eng): Demos should be <5m, one slide + short link. DM me if you need help trimming.

Alisha (CEO): Post-meeting we will publish: 3 bullets of wins, 2 ops asks, 1 product follow-up, recording link, and full Q&A. We'll pin in #all-hands. See you tomorrow! :sparkles:
